page_title: LIL 2-2 NIC | Lille v Nice 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+10' Marcin Bulka (Nice) is cautioned by the referee.
90+9' The goal by Nice won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
90+8' The Nice players halt their celebrations as referee Willy Delajod makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+8' Goal! Daouda Traore (Nice) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 2:3.
90+7' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is shown a red card even though he is not on the pitch. Unsporting behavior says the referee.

90+2' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Jordan Lotomba (Nice) makes it 2:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Tom Louchet and planted his close-range header low into the middle of the goal. Vito Mannone was helpless.
90+1' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Paulo Fonseca prepares a substitution. Edon Zhegrova is replaced by Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille).
85' Substitution. Gaetan Laborde leaves the pitch and is replaced by Aliou Balde (Nice).
84' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
81' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Nice players are visibly unhappy with the call.
80' Referee Willy Delajod makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Nice. Let’s see what happens!
79' Tom Louchet (Nice) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
76' Khephren Thuram (Nice) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
75' Substitution. Daouda Traore (Nice) in, Jean-Clair Todibo out.
75' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) replaces Jeremie Boga.
74' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) will deliver the corner kick.

73' 2 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Benjamin Andre (Lille), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go into the top left corner. The score is 2:1.
72' Angel Gomes goes off the pitch and Remy Cabella (Lille) comes on.
72' Substitution. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson is replaced by Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille).
65' Francesco Farioli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jordan Lotomba (Nice) replacing Alexis Claude-Maurice.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Terem Moffi (Nice) comes onto the pitch for Evann Guessand.
64' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) gets booked.
62' Nice force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
61' Yellow card. Alexsandro (Lille) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
58' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
55' 1 - 1 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:1.
55' Jonathan David (Lille) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The linesman raises his flag. Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) is adjudged offside.
38' The ball rebounds to Angel Gomes (Lille) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
33' Tom Louchet (Nice) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
33' Tom Louchet (Nice) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. The ball is out of play. Nice will have a chance to score from a corner.
33' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
20' The Lille players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
14' Angel Gomes swings in the free kick towards Alexsandro (Lille), who powers a header high over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Jeremie Boga puts the ball on a plate for Gaetan Laborde (Nice), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 0:1.
3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.
2' Evann Guessand (Nice) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Lille will have the kick-off.
Willy Delajod will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
